title: Filial Piety
content_zh: To feed parents without respect is no different from keeping animals. If one does not learn when young, how will one act when old? If jade is not cut, it cannot become a vessel. If a person does not learn, they will not understand righteousness.
content_en: To feed parents without respect is no different from keeping animals. If one does not learn when young, how will one act when old? If jade is not cut, it cannot become a vessel. If a person does not learn, they will not understand righteousness.
